name: Tainted Heart
summary: In Teldrassil, Denalan gives adventurers a heart still troubled by corruption. Though its outer foul moss is gone, lingering energies remain, and he seeks to cleanse them with rich soil.

sections.title: A Corrupted Core
sections.body: Teldrassil's natural balance is troubled by a malady that warps its plants and beasts. After foul moss is stripped from a blighted growth, Denalan gives adventurers the Tainted Heart within. Darkness still clings to its tissue. Denalan hopes specially prepared, nutrient-rich earth can counter the taint and restore what was corrupted.

sections.title: Denalan's Remedy
sections.body: The Tainted Heart shows a strange vitality when placed in Denalan's enchanted planter. It burrows into the rich soil and absorbs its curative nutrients. The earth burns away the corruption, and the heart emerges alive, pulsing with clean energy and eager to defend those who healed it.

faq.answer: The Tainted Heart is the inner core of a corrupted plant found on Teldrassil. Botanist Denalan stripped away the foul moss, but the heart remains corrupted until purified.
Denalan directs adventurers to plant the Tainted Heart in his specially prepared planter at Lake Al'Ameth. The nutritive soil purifies it and clears away its unnatural corruption.

faq.q: What happens after it is planted?
faq.answer: The heart burrows into the planter's soil. Moments later, it emerges cleansed and pulsing with vitality, ready to bond with whoever restored it.

faq.q: Why is the heart corrupted in the first place?
faq.answer: A strange blight is spreading across the World Tree Teldrassil, corrupting native flora, timberlings, and wildlife throughout its boughs.

angles.text: As a Cenarion druid, cleansing the Tainted Heart offers direct insight into the creeping corruption threatening the young World Tree's health.
As an herbalist, you can appreciate Denalan's craft in mixing enriched soils that draw unnatural rot from living plant matter.
